findings.claim: applicationId and namespace are com.habitrpg.android.habitica (matches expected Play package).
Version at analyzed commit: versionName 4.11.0, base versionCode 27850; per-flavor code = base + increment (prod +0, beta +2, alpha +4, partners +6, staff +8, setup +9).
minSdk 26, targetSdk 37, compileSdk = targetSdk (37); Wear OS targetSdk 36.
Four Gradle modules: :Habitica (phone app), :wearos (Wear OS app, same applicationId), :common (shared Android UI/res/theme), :shared (Kotlin Multiplatform models).
UI is hybrid: XML layouts + ViewBinding Fragments/Activities with growing Jetpack Compose (Material3) usage, often Compose hosted inside Fragments (FragmentComposeBinding).

Stack: Kotlin, Hilt DI, Retrofit 3 + OkHttp 5 + Gson, Realm Java SDK (10.19), Coroutines, Jetpack Navigation (safeargs), Paging, WorkManager, Glance widgets, Coil 3 images, Credential Manager + Google ID sign-in.
Product flavors (dimension buildType): dev, staff, setup, partners, alpha, beta, prod; build types debug, debugIAP, release (R8 minify + resource shrink).
Firebase SDKs present: Crashlytics, Messaging, Remote Config, Performance (+ Play Services auth & wearable). Firebase Analytics library is not in the google-services bundle.
Seven runtime-relevant permissions incl. SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, POST_NOTIFICATIONS (reminders) and BILLING; biometric permissions explicitly removed.

Verified app links on https://habitica.com for MainActivity (whole host), PrefsActivity (/settings/.*) and FullProfileActivity (/profile/.*); in-app nav graph adds ~40 habitica.com deep link patterns plus custom scheme habitica://user/tasks/{taskType}.

Exported non-launcher components: TaskReceiver (action NOTIFY), DeviceCommunicationService (wearable messages), two widget configure activities. Whether TaskReceiver validates callers is not checked here.

Seven home-screen widgets: avatar stats, avatar image, dailies list, to-do list, habit button, dailies count, add task (+ multi add task); Glance-based implementation exists alongside classic providers with a migration receiver.

Main shell is MainActivity with a drawer (NavigationDrawerFragment) plus custom bottom navigation of 4 task tabs (Habits, Dailies, To-Dos, Rewards) and a center add button; destinations come from one nav graph.
Onboarding/auth is a single Compose flow in OnboardingActivity: Intro -> Login (local, Google, Apple endpoints exist) -> Username selection -> Avatar setup.
Inspected UI scope: 24 concrete user-facing activities, ~60 user-facing fragments (excl. base classes), plus Compose screens; listed in screens[].
Brand color is a purple ramp: brand_50 #36205D ... brand_300 #6133B4 (primary background/notification color) ... brand_400 #925CF3 (accent) ... brand_800 #F6F4FC; launcher background #5A2CC8.
Dark mode via values-night overrides: content background gray_1 #1A181D, window gray_5 #23202A, brand_background becomes gray_10 #34313A, text_primary flips gray_50 -> gray_700.
User-selectable app color themes: default purple + Red, Maroon, Orange, Yellow, Green, Teal, Blue, each with Dark variant; base theme Material3 DynamicColors DayNight.
Typography uses system sans-serif / sans-serif-medium (no bundled custom font in phone app); Compose type scale 12-28sp; Wear OS bundles Press Start pixel font.
Shape/spacing tokens: Compose shapes 4/8/12dp; XML radii checkbox 4dp, bar 5dp, rounded button 12dp, bottom sheet 20dp; spacing scale 4/8/16/32dp, card padding 12dp, screen margin 16dp.
Task value -> color scale: value < -20 maroon, < -10 red, < -1 orange, < 1 yellow, < 5 green, < 10 teal, else blue; 8 tone levels per hue (lightest _700 ... extra dark _1).
Stat bar colors: HP red_100 #FF6165, XP yellow_100 #FFBE5D, MP blue_100 #50B5E9; gem icon #24CC8F.
Icons are PaintCode-generated vector drawing code (HabiticaIcons.java) plus 250 drawables; game sprites fetched remotely from S3 image base URL.

Reusable components (by file presence and usage): HabiticaBottomNavigationView, HabiticaButton, LoadingButton, HabiticaSnackbar (typed: DROP, SUBSCRIBER_BENEFIT...), LabeledBar, CurrencyView/CurrencyText, PixelArtView, AppHeaderView, NPCBannerView, SegmentedControl, CollapsibleSectionView, DeathOverlay, YesterdailyDialog. Visual details beyond names not inspected for each.
API base = BuildConfig.BASE_URL (example https://habitica.com) + /api/v4/; auth via x-api-user / x-api-key headers, client tag x-client: habitica-android.

Production BASE_URL value comes from an uncommitted habitica.properties; the example equals https://habitica.com and deep links target habitica.com, so production is inferred to be https://habitica.com/api/v4/.
Secondary static endpoints on S3: mobileApp/endpoint/maintenance-android.json and deprecation-android.json (MaintenanceActivity), and mobileApp/images/ for sprites.
ApiService declares 136 endpoints; largest groups user/* (46), groups/* (25), tasks/* (21), challenges/* (9), members/* (8).
Local persistence is Realm (Java SDK) with destructive migration (deleteRealmIfMigrationNeeded); repositories split into network Impl + Realm local repo.

Sync is server-authoritative pull: full user (optionally with tasks) fetched when forced or after 3 minutes, then written to Realm; UI observes Realm flows. Task create is optimistic (local UUID first).

Task scoring is computed server-side (POST tasks/{id}/score/up|down); the response's stats/drop drive UI. A local predictive scorer exists but is behind Remote Config flag enableLocalTaskScoring (default false).

Local scorer formula: delta = 0.9747^value (value clamped to [-47.27, 21.27]); XP += round(delta * (1+0.025*INT) * priority * 6); gold += delta*priority*(1+0.02*PER)*(1+streak/100); HP -= |delta|*max(0.1,1-CON/250)*priority*2; on level-up hp reset to 50. Gear stat bonuses not applied (list built, unused).

Missed dailies: on app open when user.needsCron, a 'yesterdailies' dialog lets the user tick yesterday's due dailies before POST cron; damage itself is computed by the server (not in inspected client code).
Death: fainted when hp <= 0 -> DeathOverlay (revive endpoint user/revive); subscribers get a once-per-day 'second chance' that sets stats.hp=1 client-side via updateUser.
Level up handled by LevelUpUseCase with dialog; level 10 triggers class selection prompt (ClassSelectionActivity).
Drops are server-determined; client only displays data.drop.dialog and quest item counts in a DROP snackbar with sound.
Streak is a Task field shown as badge and used in local gold bonus; streak increment rules live server-side.

Google Play Billing: 4 gem packs (4/21/42/84 gems; sale amounts 5/30/60/125), 4 auto-renew subscriptions (1/3/6/12 months), 4 non-renewing gift subscriptions, 1 pet IAP (Jubilant Gryphatrice); purchases verified server-side via /iap/android/*.
No ad SDK is linked within inspected build files and sources; an AdMob APPLICATION_ID meta-data placeholder and disabled remote flags (enableArmoireAds/FaintAds/SpellAds) remain without call sites.

Tracking: Crashlytics + Firebase Performance, both gated on user consent (PrivacyPreferencesActivity); Firebase Analytics collection disabled in manifest and no analytics event logging API exists in AnalyticsManager.
Push notifications via FCM with 10 server-defined types (party/guild/quest invites, PMs, gifted gems/subscription, challenge won, ...); local reminders via exact alarms.
23 locales are shipped (localeFilters + locales_config), Korean (ko) included.
values-ko exists with 1540 strings in strings.xml vs 1615 in base (~95% key coverage by count; untranslated fallback to English).
Locale mismatch: 'lt' is in localeFilters but there is no values-lt dir; 8+ translated dirs (ar, cs, da, ro, sk, sr, sv, es-419) are filtered out of the build.
API credentials are protected using Android KeyStore-based helper (KeyHelper) in :common.
allowBackup=false and custom networkSecurityConfig; contents of network_security_config.xml not inspected.
